query:
UPDATE catalog_edit_requests
         SET status = 'rejected', decided_at = now(), decision_note = $3
         WHERE status = 'open'
           AND ((work_id = $1 AND edition_id IS NULL)
                OR (kind = 'work_merge' AND work_id = $2
                    AND payload ->> 'into_work_id' = ($2::bigint)::text))
